snippet.title: Volfied (PC) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A beginning to end playthrough of Taito and Empire Interactive's 1991 PC Dos arcade port, Volfied.

Volfied was a followup to the 80s mainstay Qix, juicing up the original formula with a spaceship, bugs and monsters, and (some semblance of) a narrative structure. It's extremely hard in that gratifying, old-skool Taito way. 

This was played through on hard mode, and runs through all 16 stages. This DOS port was far more accurate than most games put on PC at the time tended to be, with great Adlib music and VGA graphics. Hope you enjoy it!

_______
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
